verdict: Windows Update cannot find a required file. Missing or corrupt content in the SoftwareDistribution folder, or a partial previous update left the CBS store in an inconsistent state.
fix: From elevated PowerShell: `Stop-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc,msiserver -Force; Rename-Item $env:windir\SoftwareDistribution SoftwareDistribution.old -EA SilentlyContinue; Rename-Item $env:windir\System32\catroot2 catroot2.old -EA SilentlyContinue; Start-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc,msiserver; sfc /scannow; DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth`. If the client is MECM-managed, also clear the CCM cache entry for the update content and force a policy refresh.
